note: The board lives in the repository, so the bus and the source of truth are the same object. A turn reads this, does one task, and writes it back to master.

tasks.title: parse the retry hint out of a rate-limited response body
tasks.description: Create apps/api/src/lib/retry.ts exporting a pure function parseRetryAfterMs(body: string): number. It must handle three shapes a provider might use: a JSON field retry_after (seconds, possibly a string), the phrase 'retry after N seconds', and the phrase 'every N seconds'. Return milliseconds, capped at 300000. Return 0 when nothing is found. No I/O, no dependencies.
tasks.acceptance: pure function; returns 0 when no hint; caps at 300000; handles all three shapes

tasks.title: assert the replay window at its boundary
tasks.description: Create apps/api/src/lib/replay.window.test.ts with tests for the existing ReplayGuard in apps/api/src/lib/replay.ts: a signature exactly at the window edge is accepted, one millisecond past it is refused, and a timestamp far in the future is refused rather than accepted.
tasks.acceptance: the boundary is asserted explicitly, not approximately
